synthesizedFacts.fact: Salicylic acid is a Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA) used in skincare to exfoliate the skin by dissolving the bonds between dead skin cells, helping in skin regeneration and preventing clogged pores.
Moisturizers for oily and acne-prone skin should be non-comedogenic and have a lightweight texture to avoid clogging pores.
Using a moisturizer is crucial even for oily skin to maintain skin health and prevent overproduction of oil.
